name: lease-review
title: 租赁审查
description: Professional lease contract review for Taiwan rental agreements.  Supports residential, commercial/storefront, and parking space leases. Analyzes clauses for illegality, unfairness, and risk per Taiwan's Lease Protection Act (租賃專法) and standardized contract rules. Use when: (1) Reviewing a rental agreement before signing, (2) Checking if specific clauses are legal/enforceable, (3) Comparing tenant vs landlord rights, (4) Rewriting risky clauses to fair versions.
